name: witcher
description: The Witcher 3 persona: vitality, stamina and toxicity HUD above the prompt, game sounds, Corvo Bianco and Kaer Morhen themes, campfire spinner and status lines, a /timer break screen

spinnerSeconds.title: Spinner verb, seconds
spinnerSeconds.description: How often the spinner moves to the next verb while a turn runs

toxicityThreshold.title: Toxicity mark, % of context
toxicityThreshold.description: Where the toxicity bar marks the handoff line; it turns red 10 points past it

breakScreen.title: Break screen size
breakScreen.description: How the /timer break screen opens: a window in the middle of the main monitor, or every monitor covered

turnDoneSound.title: Sound: answer ready
turnDoneSound.description: Plays when Claude finishes a turn and nothing runs in the background

needsYouSound.title: Sound: needs you
needsYouSound.description: Plays the moment Claude asks for a permission or a question

timerDoneSound.title: Sound: break timer
timerDoneSound.description: Plays when the /timer break reminder rings
